Our expansive 6,000-square-foot showroom transforms how customers experience cannabis through transparency, education, and genuine craft.This direct connection between consumer and production builds trust. It demonstrates our core philosophy: cannabis should be clean, authentic, and crafted with meticulous care. From premium flower to artisanal edibles and potent concentrates, Treasure Valley Cannabis Company delivers products that embody Oregon craft cannabis at its finest.Vertically Integrated Cannabis in Ontario, OregonTreasure Valley’s vertically integrated model means everything—from seed to sale—stays managed in-house. We cultivate our own cannabis on our Applegate farms and process it under strict quality standards. This ensures customers receive products that are consistent, safe, and effective. Our system also enables innovation, giving our cultivation and lab teams the flexibility to experiment with genetics, terpenes, and extraction techniques that push cannabis quality boundaries. Customers can trust that every product on our shelves has been crafted with identical care and precision.Inside Our In-House Solventless LabOne standout feature of Treasure Valley is our in-house solventless lab. Instead of relying on harsh chemicals, our lab uses heat, pressure, and filtration to create concentrates that retain the plant’s natural cannabinoids and terpenes. Visitors to our dispensary look through windows into the lab. They watch the process of pressing rosin, creating hash, and refining solventless cartridges in real time. This emphasis on solventless methods ensures products are both clean and potent. The result: consumers experience pure cannabis in its most authentic form.Why Solventless Extraction Sets Us ApartSolventless products are prized for their purity. By avoiding hydrocarbons or chemical solvents, Treasure Valley’s rosin, hash, and solventless cartridges preserve the full spectrum of the plant. This results in concentrates that are not only powerful but also true to the strain’s natural profile. Customers consistently describe these products as more flavorful, aromatic, and nuanced than traditional extracts. The difference is immediately apparent—both in taste and effect.Product ProfilesPremium Oregon-Grown FlowerGrown on our Applegate farms, Treasure Valley’s flower represents the foundation of our brand. Every strain is cultivated with care, using techniques that highlight terpene expression and cannabinoid richness. Expect consistent quality across our selection. We maintain energizing sativas, balanced hybrids, and relaxing indicas that deliver reliable experiences every time.Solventless Vape CartridgesTreasure Valley’s solventless cartridges have become a customer favorite. They provide full-spectrum effects in a portable format. Crafted with rosin extracted in our lab, these cartridges capture the true essence of each strain. Consumers enjoy the smooth vapor, rich terpene flavor, and reliable potency that solventless carts consistently deliver. Each cartridge represents hours of careful extraction and refinement.Small-Batch Hash & RosinOur in-house lab produces small-batch hash and rosin that cater to concentrate enthusiasts. Each batch is pressed to perfection, delivering dense, flavorful hits packed with cannabinoids and terpenes. Hash lovers appreciate the authenticity of Treasure Valley’s methods. Rosin fans can explore strains in their most flavorful form, experiencing the plant’s complete terpene profile with every dab.Solventless Edible GummiesTreasure Valley’s edibles are infused with solventless extracts, ensuring a clean, consistent dose in every bite. We craft them into gummies, chocolates, and baked treats that provide flavorful experiences with reliable effects. Our extraction methods carry over into our edibles, maintaining the clean profile that defines our brand.Dab-Ready ConcentratesFor those seeking high-potency experiences, Treasure Valley provides dab-ready concentrates from our lab. These products highlight the craftsmanship of solventless extraction. They deliver rich, terpene-forward flavor alongside powerful effects that satisfy even the most discerning concentrate enthusiasts.Hand-Rolled Cannabis Pre-RollsTreasure Valley offers both single pre-rolls and multi-pack options, rolled with the same premium flower cultivated on their farm. These convenient formats are perfect for sampling different strains or enjoying a ready-to-use session without preparation. Consistency in grind, roll, and burn quality make their pre-rolls a reliable choice for everyday use.FAQWhat makes Treasure Valley Cannabis Company different?Our vertically integrated model and in-house solventless lab ensure quality, consistency, and transparency at every stage of the process. This produces concentrates that are pure, flavorful, and strain-true while maintaining the plant’s natural profile.Can customers see the hash production process?Absolutely. Treasure Valley’s dispensary features viewing windows into the on-site lab, allowing customers to see how solventless cartridges, hash, dab, and edibles are made in real time.What products are available?Treasure Valley provides premium flower, solventless cartridges, rosin, hash, edibles, and dab concentrates—all crafted in our facility.Why choose solventless products?They deliver a cleaner, more natural cannabis experience with richer terpene flavor and full-spectrum effects that honor the plant’s complete profile.Is Treasure Valley locally owned?Yes. The company is rooted in Oregon, with cultivation in Applegate and our flagship dispensary in Ontario serving the community.Who are Treasure Valley products best for?Both new consumers seeking safe, approachable products and connoisseurs chasing craft-quality concentrates will discover something exceptional in our selection.

Nexus cards cannot be accepted.How much cannabis can I purchase?A customer cannot purchase more than the following amounts at any one time or within one day:Two ounces of usable marijuana if a recreational consumer;Eight ounces of usable marijuana at any one time or within one day, and no more than 32 ounces in one calendar month if an OMMP registry identification cardholder or designated caregiver;16 ounces of a cannabinoid product in solid form;72 ounces of a cannabinoid product in liquid form;Ten grams of cannabinoid products intended for inhalation (smoking or vaporizing);Ten grams of cannabinoid extracts or concentrates, whether sold alone or contained in an inhalant delivery system;Four immature marijuana plants; and Ten marijuana seeds.I'm a registered OMMP patient, but I'm 18 years old.  Can I buy marijuana from an OLCC retailer?OLCC retailers selling marijuana for medical purposes can sell medical marijuana to OMMP patients 18 years of age or older.How old do I have to be to visit TVCC?You must be 21 years or older with valid ID to enter a dispensary (or 18 years old with a valid Oregon medical registry identification card).If I forgot my ID or am not 21 yet but want to just look around, can I?No. You must be 21 years or older with valid ID to enter a dispensary.When can I smoke/use recreational marijuana?As of July 1, 2015, Oregonians are allowed to grow up to four plants per household, and possess up to eight ounces of usable marijuana in their homes and up to one ounce on their person. Recreational marijuana cannot be sold or smoked in public.Recreational marijuana can be consumed by individuals over 21 years of age in any private, non-public place, assuming you have permission to do so.Can I smoke marijuana in a bar/restaurant?Marijuana cannot be smoked or used in a public place. The OLCC considers any establishment with a state liquor license to be public, including patios or decks set aside for smokers. Allowing marijuana use may put an establishment’s liquor license in jeopardy. In addition, smoking and vaping in most businesses is limited by the Indoor Clean Air Act.What is the definition of a public place?Chapter 475C defines a public place as “a place to which the general public has access and includes, but is not limited to, hallways, lobbies, and other parts of apartment houses and hotels not constituting rooms or apartments designed for actual residence, and highways, streets, schools, places of amusement, parks, playgrounds and premises used in connection with public passenger transportation.Who can smoke recreational marijuana? What is the minimum age?As of July 1, 2015, anyone at least 21 years of age can consume recreational marijuana in Oregon. Marijuana use or possession of recreational marijuana by anyone under 21 years of age is illegal. That includes home consumption.Can Oregon recreational marijuana be taken to the state of Washington or California where it is also legal?No. Taking marijuana across state lines is a federal offense.Can I get a DUI under the influence of marijuana?Current laws for DUII have not changed. Driving under the influence of intoxicants (DUII) refers to operating a motor vehicle while intoxicated or drugged, including impairment from the use of marijuana. I
